measure.measure_definition: Occurrence: development of clinical RA from treatment initiation to month 36; Participants; Clinical RA evaluation was triggered by ≥1 joint with RA-like synovitis on physical examination; assessment used the 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria and imaging when applicable through month 36.; Clinical RA defined by 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria score ≥6, or a joint examination with RA-like synovitis plus ≥1 bone erosion on x-ray of hands, wrists, and feet. Time origin was treatment initiation; event was clinical RA by month 36. Under the intercurrent event strategy, one HCQ participant was censored before clinical RA due to use of a prohibited medication.

Occurrence: development of inflammatory arthritis from treatment initiation to month 36; Participants; Physician joint examinations at clinic visits were used to identify swollen joints due to IA.; IA defined as development of ≥1 swollen joint consistent with rheumatoid arthritis-like (RA-like) synovitis. Time origin was treatment initiation; event was IA by month 36. Supplementary Table S8 reports the 36-month IA counts, Kaplan-Meier risk estimates and between-arm risk difference.

Measured value: number of painful joints reported by the participant among 42 assessed joints; Participants; Participant self-reported joint symptoms assessment using a body-joint diagram; 42 joints assessed were hand (proximal interphalangeal and metacarpophalangeal), wrist, elbow, shoulder, hip, knee, ankle (including subtalar and talocalcaneal), and foot (metatarsophalangeal) joints on both sides. Participants indicated joints painful on the day of visit or in the past week. Summary statistics used participants with evaluable data at baseline or month 36.; Count of painful joints among the full 42-joint assessment, not restricted to participants with >0 painful joints. Medians and min–max summaries were calculated across participants; differences in medians are HCQ − placebo with bootstrap confidence intervals. Month-36 summaries use observed data, not LOCF.
measure.measure_name: Participant-reported painful joints over the full 42-joint assessment
